label: Ambrogio and Evangelista de Predis

claims.statement: Partners in the 1483 Virgin of the Rocks contract. A long dispute over payment was settled in the later years.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Contract of 25 April 1483; later arbitration.

claims.statement: On 25 April 1483 the Confraternity of the Immaculate Conception (prior Bartolomeo Scorlione) contracted Leonardo and the brothers Evangelista and Giovanni Ambrogio de Predis for the painted parts of their altarpiece in San Francesco Grande. Notary: Antonio de' Capitani (to confirm).

open_questions: Group record of two brothers; separate bars recommended (pe-ambrogio-predis, pe-evangelista-predis). Evangelista died c.1490 to 1491, so the bar to 1508 applies only to Ambrogio.
